## `admin-access-requests list`

Retrieves the list of Authorization Request with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli admin-access-requests list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/AdminAccessRequest` · Response: `AdminAccessRequestModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--decision` | string |  | Decision Filter |
| `--created-on` | string |  | Created on Date Filter - Format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ |
| `--active-only` | switch |  | Active Only Filter |
| `--modified-on` | string |  | Modify on Date Folter - Format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ |
| `--computer-id` | UUID |  | Computer Id |
| `--endpoint-user-id` | string |  | Computer User Id |
| `--endpoint-user-name` | string |  | Computer User Name |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli admin-access-requests list --all -o json
```

## `admin-access-requests create`

Creates an Admin Access Request on behalf of a user. Include "decision" and "decisionPerformedByUser" with valid values to create a pre-approved request; otherwise a pending request is created.

```
epm-cli admin-access-requests create [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/AdminAccessRequest`

**Request body** (JSON, `ExternalAdminRequestModel`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--computer-id` | `computerId` | UUID |  | ComputerId |
| `--duration` | `duration` | string |  | Duration |
| `--user-id` | `userId` | string |  | UserId |
| `--user-name` | `userName` | string |  | User Name |
| `--reason` | `reason` | string |  | Reason |
| `--system-id` | `systemId` | string |  | System Id |
| `--ticket-id` | `ticketId` | string |  | Ticket Id |
| `--ticket-url` | `ticketUrl` | string |  | Ticket Url |
| `--decision` | `decision` | string |  | Decision |
| `--decision-performed-by-user` | `decisionPerformedByUser` | string |  | Decision performed by user |
| `--message` | `message` | string |  | Message |

Other or nested fields: `--set path=value`, or pass the whole body with `--body` (inline, `@file.json` or `-` for stdin). Example body (`--body-template`):

```json
{
  "computerId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "duration": "",
  "userId": "",
  "userName": "",
  "reason": "",
  "systemId": "",
  "ticketId": "",
  "ticketUrl": "",
  "decision": "",
  "decisionPerformedByUser": "",
  "message": ""
}
```

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli admin-access-requests create --computer-id <VALUE>
```

## `admin-access-requests decide`

Updates an Admin Access Request decision which can be approved or denied

```
epm-cli admin-access-requests decide [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/AdminAccessRequest/approval`

**Request body** (JSON, `AdminRequestDecisionModel`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | `requestId` | UUID |  | Request Identifier. |
| `--decision` | `decision` | string |  | Decision. Valid values are "Approved" and "Denied". |
| `--duration` | `duration` | string |  | Duration of the JIT Admin Session in seconds. |
| `--decision-performed-by-user` | `decisionPerformedByUser` | string |  | User that is updating the JIT Admin Request. |
| `--message` | `message` | string |  | Message from the decision maker. |
| `--system-id` | `systemId` | string |  | Internal id of item associated with approval. |
| `--ticket-id` | `ticketId` | string |  | External id of item associated with approval. |
| `--ticket-url` | `ticketUrl` | string |  | Url of the item associated with approval. |

Other or nested fields: `--set path=value`, or pass the whole body with `--body` (inline, `@file.json` or `-` for stdin). Example body (`--body-template`):

```json
{
  "requestId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "decision": "",
  "duration": "",
  "decisionPerformedByUser": "",
  "message": "",
  "systemId": "",
  "ticketId": "",
  "ticketUrl": ""
}
```

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli admin-access-requests decide --request-id <VALUE>
```
